page_title: INT 4-0 FIO | Inter v Fiorentina 03/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+4' Matteo Marchetti couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Carlos Augusto (Inter) and blew his whistle.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' Fiorentina have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
88' Flag up against M'Bala Nzola (Fiorentina). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
86' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) trips an opposition player and Matteo Marchetti signals a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Fiorentina.
83' A neat pass is well received by Lautaro Martinez (Inter), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball on goal. The goalkeeper makes a decent save to block his shot.
78' The game has come to an end for Hakan Calhanoglu. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Kristjan Asllani (Inter).
75' Vincenzo Italiano has decided to substitute Arthur Melo and he is replaced by Lorenzo Amatucci (Fiorentina).
75' A cooling break is underway.
73' 4 - 0 Fantastic team goal! Lautaro Martinez (Inter) was set free in the area by Juan Cuadrado and made no mistake with a lovely finish into the top of the net. 4:0.
70' Substitution. Marko Arnautovic (Inter) replaces Marcus Thuram.
70' Simone Inzaghi decides to make a substitution. Federico Dimarco will be replaced by Carlos Augusto (Inter).
70' Here's the change. Denzel Dumfries leaves the pitch and Juan Cuadrado (Inter) comes on as a substitute.
69' Matteo Marchetti blows his whistle and it's Josip Brekalo (Fiorentina) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
63' Marcus Thuram (Inter) spurned a good chance! He gets a shot away from inside the penalty box, but it goes inches wide of the left post.
62' Dodo (Fiorentina) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
59' Nicolo Barella goes off the pitch and Davide Frattesi (Inter) comes on.
58' 3 - 0 Goal! Oliver Christensen gets a hand on the penalty from Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter), but can't stop it from flying into the top right corner.
58' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) is going to take the penalty!
57' Oliver Christensen (Fiorentina) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Matteo Marchetti signals. The referee blows his whistle and awards Inter a penalty after chaos inside the box.
55' Vincenzo Italiano prepares a substitution. Nicolas Gonzalez is replaced by Gino Infantino (Fiorentina).
55' The substitution is prepared. Josip Brekalo (Fiorentina) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Giacomo Bonaventura.

53' 2 - 0 Marcus Thuram is in a good shooting position, but he sees his teammate and passes the ball to him. Lautaro Martinez (Inter) takes it nicely and beats the goalkeeper with a precise shot into the bottom left corner to make the score 2:0.
53' Oliver Christensen produces a crucial save to deny a close-range header from Lautaro Martinez (Inter) after a cross. A top class save by the keeper.
50' Denzel Dumfries (Inter) gathers the ball inside the box and produces a snap shot. The ball, though, only brushes the left post.
50' Nicolas Gonzalez (Fiorentina) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
48' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) commits a rough foul. Matteo Marchetti stops the game and makes a call.
46' Half-time substitution. Vincenzo Italiano decided to make a change. Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina) is replaced by M'Bala Nzola.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Christian Kouame (Fiorentina) is replaced by Riccardo Sottil.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+6' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+6' Nicolo Barella (Inter) receives a yellow card for chasing the referee and shouting at him.
45+5' Matteo Marchetti interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Nikola Milenkovic (Fiorentina).
45+5' Denzel Dumfries (Inter) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
45+3' Nicolo Barella (Inter) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' What a big chance! Marcus Thuram (Inter) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and skies the ball well over the bar.
45' Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area.
42' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) will take a corner kick.
39' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Luca Ranieri (Fiorentina) was quite harsh and Matteo Marchetti didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
37' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Fiorentina for a penalty. Play continues.

34' Great chance! Lautaro Martinez (Inter) controls a rebound inside the box. He only has the keeper to beat, but his shot flies just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Fiorentina will have a goal kick.
34' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter).
32' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) probably handled the ball. Inter are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
30' What a big chance! Marcus Thuram (Inter) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball a whisker wide of the right post.
30' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
25' The referee blows for a cooling break.
23' 1 - 0 Goal! Marcus Thuram (Inter) makes the score 1:0 after burying a close-range header in the middle of the goal after a good run and cross by Federico Dimarco.
22' Matteo Marchetti blows for a foul after Denzel Dumfries (Inter) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
20' Marcus Thuram (Inter) get himself out of a tight corner inside the box then shoots. The keeper leaps for the ball but it flies just over the bar.
18' Foul! Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) is penalised for pulling back his opponent.
17' Matteo Marchetti blows his whistle. Matteo Darmian (Inter) commits a foul after dangerous play.
15' Giacomo Bonaventura (Fiorentina) received a pass and didn't think long what to do with it. He fired a powerful long-range shot which went painfully close to the bar.
14' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
13' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Fiorentina.

10' What a save from Oliver Christensen! Marcus Thuram (Inter) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant stop to keep it out.
9' Nicolas Gonzalez (Fiorentina) commits a rough challenge and Matteo Marchetti blows his whistle for a foul.
8' The Fiorentina players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
3' Great touch by Federico Dimarco (Inter) as he receives a precise pass deep inside the box and rips a shot goalwards, but the keeper pulls off an amazing save!
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are on the pitch and Fiorentina will have the kick-off.
Matteo Marchetti is the one to supervise the game today.
Show lineups In the details of this match, you can glance at the lineups while the game is about to begin.
